description: Eval opportunity for the Rantai Supply sample seller (PRD 12 v3.1, ADR-0012 D3), from docs/product/personas/rantai-supply.md section 12.2. The prospect is fictional, so research may find little: the checks are on intake, fit, pricing and review. IDs refer to web/src/lib/sample/rantai-supply.ts. A pricing line is checked only if the Pricing step selects it; when it does, code must copy exactly this text and calculate exactly this total.

inputs.text:
REQUEST FOR QUOTATION MUC/ICT/2026/07
Staff laptop and lab workstation refresh
Mahligai University College, with campuses in Shah Alam, Penang and Kuching.

Background
We are replacing 600 staff laptops and lab PCs before the semester that starts on 12 January 2027. Everything must be in place on all three campuses by then.

Requirements
R1. 520 staff laptops: 14-inch screen, at least 16 GB memory and a 512 GB SSD, a fingerprint reader, and a 3-year on-site warranty.
R2. 130 engineering lab workstations certified for CAD software.
R3. Every device imaged with the college's standard image and enrolled in our device management service.
R4. Devices delivered and set up on all three campuses by 12 January 2027: about 400 in Shah Alam, and about 250 between Penang and Kuching.
R5. Collect and wipe the 600 devices being replaced, with a certificate for each device, and buy back the ones that still work.
R6. An option to lease all the devices for three years instead of buying them.
R7. Failed drives must stay with the college.
R8. Upgrade the Wi-Fi in two lecture halls on the Shah Alam campus.
R9. Prices must be held for 90 days, for our finance committee.

Quotation format
Price the purchase and the lease options separately. State how long the prices are valid, and the delivery schedule for each campus.

gaps.need: 520 staff laptops to a spec, with a 3-year on-site warranty
gaps.note: The Office 14 meets every spec line. The on-site upgrade turns its carry-in warranty into next-business-day on-site.

gaps.need: Delivered and set up on three campuses by 12 January 2027
gaps.note: Kuching takes 10 to 15 working days. Feasible if the order lands by early December.

gaps.need: Collect, wipe with certificates and buy back 600 old devices
Option to lease for three years
gaps.note: 36-month term, after Cendana Leasing's credit check (con_daas_min: 650 devices is above 25).

gaps.need: Failed drives stay with the college
Wi-Fi upgrade in two lecture halls

instead.why: Partner Jentayu Networks quotes the customer directly.
Hardware prices are valid for 14 days. Taviro's deal registration can hold a project price for up to 60 days.

onQuote.why: 520 laptops fall in the 200+ band: a project price, never an invented number (FR-FIT-5b)

pricing.note: The buy and lease options are never added together. The lease's monthly lines share one period, so they may have a subtotal: RM 100,230 / month.
